relationships.subject: MAOB
relationships.evidence_quote: Taken together, these findings indicate that reactive astrocytes aberrantly synthesize GABA through the enzymatic action of MAOB in neuropathic pain model rats.

relationships.subject: MAOB inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that pharmacological inhibition of MAOB significantly reduced the expression of astrocytic MAOB and GABA in the ipsilateral dorsal horn

relationships.subject: spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: KCC2 expression levels were significantly lower in the ipsilateral dorsal horn than in the contralateral dorsal horn of the SNL-operated rats

relationships.subject: astrocytic GABA
relationships.evidence_quote: Overall, our results suggest that astrocytic GABA paradoxically activates dorsal horn neuronal action potential firings in a neuropathic pain model and may amplify or maintain pain signals.

relationships.subject: L655,708
relationships.evidence_quote: However, in the SNL-operated rats, L655,708 (10 μM) significantly suppressed the firing frequency, indicating that the excitatory action of extrasynaptic GABA mainly originates from astrocytes

relationships.subject: CLP257
relationships.evidence_quote: preincubation of spinal cord slices with CLP257 (5 μM), a KCC2 enhancer, restored the abnormal function of GABA from excitatory to inhibitory in SNL-operated rats

relationships.subject: MAOB inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that intraspinal treatment with MAOBi via an osmotic pump for 2 weeks significantly decreased glucose metabolism in the ipsilateral dorsal horn.

relationships.subject: MAOB inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, inhibiting MAOB restored the entire astrocytic GABA-mediated cascade and abrogated the increased glucose metabolism and mechanical allodynia.

key_findings: After SNL, reactive dorsal horn astrocytes synthesize excess GABA via MAOB, producing tonic GABA currents that excite neurons because KCC2 downregulation depolarizes EGABA; CLP257 restored inhibitory GABA action.
Spinal MAOB inhibition normalized astrocytic GABA, tonic excitation, dorsal horn FDG glucose hypermetabolism and mechanical allodynia, but did not restore KCC2 levels.
